evals.name: chronicle-kernel-to-studio
evals.prompt: A Chronicle kernel fix is intended to solve a Studio integration bug. Plan local proof before the producer PR, without pushing an image or waiting for publication. Include commands and success conditions. Reply only; do not execute anything.
evals.expected_output: Execute the helper to generate one next-patch local stamp, pack the full dependency closure, publish the correct kernel RID and Workbench assets, build the local development-slim image, and select it using CHRONICLE_KERNEL_VERSION in Studio. Run the actual failing spec and required consumer gates, check both repositories, restore, check again and dry-run cleanup before apply.
assertions: Uses one next-patch prerelease stamp for NuGet packages and the kernel image, explaining NU1605 avoidance.
Includes Chronicle.CodeAnalysis dependency closure, kernel publish RID/architecture, and Workbench wwwroot before Docker build.
Selects Studio's local image with CHRONICLE_KERNEL_VERSION and never pushes it.
Requires a passing reproducing integration spec and CI-equivalent consumer gates rather than treating a build as behavioral proof.
Runs check before consumer commits/pushes, restore plus check at the end, and clean dry-run before --apply.

evals.name: components-to-studio-frontend
evals.prompt: Components has a dialog fix that needs proof in Studio's frontend. How should the engineer consume and test a local build, avoiding duplicate React and preserving unrelated manifest edits? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Build and pack real Yarn tarballs, use-npm to add file resolutions with saved backups, install and invalidate only stale Vite prebundles, then run frontend checks and reproduce the UI bug. Avoid link/portal. Restore only reviewed overlay edits, honoring lockfile conflict refusal, and clean stamped artifacts.
assertions: Builds the producer before pack-npm and consumes real file tarballs through use-npm rather than link or portal.
Mentions duplicate React/context risk and stale Vite prebundles.
Requires frontend build/specs and exercising the originally broken dialog.
Preserves pre-existing edits and explains manual review when restore refuses a changed yarn.lock.
Finishes with restore, check and scoped dry-run cleanup followed by --apply.

evals.name: overlay-at-commit-boundary
evals.prompt: An agent is about to commit Studio while a NuGet env overlay and npm file resolutions remain active. yarn install has changed yarn.lock. What must happen before commit and push? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Stop the commit, execute check and treat findings or inability to run as blocking. Review npm backups and lockfile edits without checkout/reset of unrelated work, restore overlay-only changes, unset shell properties and image selection, rerun check, then commit only intended code. Cleanup is stamp-scoped and reviewed.
assertions: Requires check before both commit and push; exit 1 is findings and exit 2 is could-not-run, neither passes.
Explains check scans changed tracked lines and non-ignored untracked files, not active ignored/env overlays or committed history.
Does not force restore or overwrite unrelated changes when the lockfile differs from the backup.
Requires removing the overlay and unsetting environment properties, followed by restore plus a passing check.
Scopes cleanup to the task stamp and reviews dry-run subjects before applying.

evals.name: local-proof-is-not-shipping
evals.prompt: The downstream bug is gone with local packages. Can we skip releasing the producer and just commit the local pins? Also, can this workflow run on Linux without a machine build queue? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: No: local verification replaces waiting, not shipping. Release through the normal authorized producer workflow and bump the consumer to released versions after removing local overrides. The portable helper works without CRATIS_LOCAL_RUN; put feeds in the workspace and load images into the job daemon. Local success alone does not authorize publication.
assertions: Explicitly says local verification replaces waiting, not shipping, and rejects committing local pins.
Retains the producer release and consumer released-version pin bump under their normal workflow and authority.
Describes Linux or agent-host execution without requiring the Mac-specific pi-phase adapter.
Requires workspace-accessible feeds, images in the job's daemon, and matching architecture.
Retains leak checks, restoration and cleanup on that host.
